text: The last video, and it isn't a highlight reel. Veridian went from three divisions disagreeing on one number to a real governance program -- here's what's solid, and what isn't.
What's real: five sources registered and scanned, named ownership everywhere, two separately governed terms replacing one undocumented blend, and a real compliance gap found and fixed.
What's still manual: the checklist needs a human to run and close it, only two conflicts of likely several are resolved, and master data management, flagged in Lesson 3, hasn't started.
Saying that plainly is the point. Overselling completeness is exactly the trust problem this series spent its first half fixing.
Twenty videos, one real program, three named gaps for whoever picks this up next. Thank you for following the whole Veridian Holdings build.
